en.headline: National Ecology Day exhibition runs through Sunday in Kwun Tong
en.dek: The Countryside Conservation Office’s free show at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, combining Mirs Bay photography, village stories and live countryside music, is scheduled to close on 6 September.
body: The National Ecology Day Thematic Exhibition 2026, organised by the Countryside Conservation Office under the Environment and Ecology Bureau, continues at The Corner on the ground floor of the East Kowloon Cultural Centre until Sunday, 6 September.

The Environment and Ecology Bureau said the display is built around three themes — Mirs Bay, Hong Kong; Nature Conservation; and Village Stories — with interactive multimedia, Hakka cultural elements, and landscape photographs of Yan Chau Tong by Kelvin Yuen set to music by composer Tan Dun. Opening hours are 11am to 8pm and admission is free.

The office has also scheduled countryside music performances and a photographer sharing at the centre’s theatre. The government said the programme marks the fourth National Ecology Day and is intended to encourage visits to the countryside. Visitors heading this weekend should check the office’s listing for which sessions remain available, as some Saturday performances have been listed as sold out.
Correction: The photographer’s Chinese name is Yuen Sze-lok (Kelvin Yuen).

zh.headline: 全國生態日專題展觀塘續開至周日
zh.dek: 鄉郊保育辦事處在東九文化中心「隅」舉辦的免費展覽結合印洲塘影像、鄉村故事及鄉郊音樂，展期至九月六日。
body: 環境及生態局轄下鄉郊保育辦事處主辦的「全國生態日2026專題展覽」，繼續在東九文化中心地面層展覽空間「隅」舉行，展期至九月六日（星期日）。
當局表示，展覽圍繞「香港印洲塘」、「自然保育」及「鄉村故事」三個主題，設互動多媒體、客家文化體驗，以及攝影師袁斯樂拍攝印洲塘景色、配以譚盾音樂的影像。開放時間為上午十一時至晚上八時，免費入場。
辦事處亦在文化中心劇院安排鄉郊音樂演出及攝影師分享。政府指活動配合第四個全國生態日，鼓勵市民認識本港鄉郊。周末前往的市民宜查閱官方場次資料，部分周六演出已標示售罄。
更正：上文攝影師中文姓名為袁斯樂。
